why: Three open, all in the `npm-search` intent, raised 2026-11-15 for the owner to close at its Design→Build acceptance: whether spec R5 may amend positioning R7 to say "Drop-in alternative to", that npm publishes no query volume, and whether the four broad phrases swap for narrower reachable ones. Raised from 0 so they are counted rather than written as closed. Before: zero open. The three in the `validator` intent (the drop-in subset, where it lands against apicontract's phases, whether it needs a model) closed with its design on 2026-11-13 (D-20261113-validator-design). Before: 3 from 2026-11-12, raised from 0 so they were counted rather than written as closed; 102 first read, 94 once items carrying their own answer stopped counting, 70 after the package design questions (D-013..D-033), 45 after the infrastructure ones (D-034..D-049), 0 after the last sweep (D-056..D-072). The ceiling at zero is the point: the next question raised is visible the moment it is raised, and it either closes in .sdlc/decisions/ or this number moves deliberately with the reason beside it. A backlog is only invisible while nothing counts it.
